body: yep seem to be a bug

This is unfortunate as we have these conditions in Angular right now. We can change the code on our side, if this is bug not going to be resolved anytime soon (I would understand that it gets low priority given that it happens in very odd conditions).

As workaround you can disable module concatenation until this is resolved:

``` js
optimization.concatenateModules: false
```

(webpack 4)
